findings.description: The separator logic was inverted during the refactor. The original code used `"; " if any_prefix_is_slash else " / "`, but the new code uses `"; " if not any_prefix_is_slash else " / "`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option with secondary opts, such as a boolean flag `--shout/--no-shout`. The original joined with " / " when no slash prefix was present and with "; " when one was. The new code swaps these, so help output changes from `--shout / --no-shout` to `--shout; --no-shout`. The same swap applies to slash-prefixed options. Every help page that lists such flags changes.
